rows.resolution_note: p002 sentence 1 attributes the pQTL data to UKB-PPP with the citation Sun et al. 2023 (DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6, PMID 37794186, the source of four pqtl rows) and gives the ancestry 'European-ancestry', which among those rows is the ancestry of the discovery row only (rule E). The '2940' participants equals no row's N and so identifies no other release (rule H); no other passage gives a conflicting identifier.
rows.quote: We extracted pQTL data from 2940 European‐ancestry participants in the UKB‐PPP database (B. B. Sun et al. 2023).
rows.reference_quote: Sun , B. B. , J. Chiou , M. Traylor , et al. 2023 . “ Plasma Proteomic Associations With Genetics and Health in the UK Biobank .” Nature 622 , no. 7982 : 329 – 338 . 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6 . 37794186 PMC10567551
